I got my teeth done here, and I can tell you the place is incredibly clean. Honestly, just seeing how clean it is is enough to make me feel confident. I once saw a friend get her teeth cleaned at the clinic and then her gums came back inflamed, requiring a long period of treatment. So I decided to get my teeth done at the hospital. I had to wait a little bit, but I was assured of the cleanliness. I think at least if something happens, there will be specialists in other fields to take care of them. There's also an emergency room, so I'm confident. I've heard people say the wait is long, but for me, the place is spacious and comfortable. I didn't feel uncomfortable even after waiting a little bit. I'd recommend it.

They didn't mention that there were already scheduled appointments waiting in the morning. This meant I had to wait in both the scheduled and walk-in queues upon arrival. Furthermore, they said I might not be able to see the doctor in the morning, meaning I'd have to wait until the afternoon, and since the afternoon slots were full, I'd have to come back another day. It was a huge waste of time and a terrible experience. The staff should have informed me from the start that there were queues in the morning and that I might not see the doctor that day, so I could have gone elsewhere.

The dental clinic is located inside Building A of Chulalongkorn 3 Hospital. The clinic isn't very large, with a separate waiting area from the air-conditioned main area. Patients can park in the hospital's parking garage and get their parking ticket stamped at the clinic's counter for free parking.

I visited on a Saturday morning, around the end of May, for a tartar removal procedure. I was able to use my private insurance at the clinic. There were quite a few patients waiting inside, about eight ahead of me. Combined with the fact that there were only a few doctors available, the waiting time was very long, approximately two hours.

Overall, the clinic was relatively clean. The waiting area chairs were a bit small, and the air conditioning inside the clinic was quite warm. While the wait was long, the doctor provided good care during my visit.
